cohort: 22 million singleton live births without major malformations in the United States from 2006 to 2013.
finding: In the United States, there was a decline in spontaneous deliveries associated with an overall decline in neonatal mortality.
mod_finding: Neonatal mortality rates declined among spontaneous deliveries, while remaining unchanged among clinician-initiated deliveries, despite an increase in clinician-initiated deliveries at 39 to 40 weeks.
